units.source_text: 那是我對人類最後的求愛。

en.t: That was my final plea for love from humankind.

units.source_text: 儘管我對人類極度恐懼，卻怎麼也無法對人類死心。

en.t: Although I was terrified of human beings to an extreme degree, I still could not give up on them.

units.source_text: 於是我藉著搞笑這一條線，與人類保持了一絲的聯絡。

en.t: And so, through the single thread of clowning, I kept a faint connection with human beings.

units.source_text: 表面上我不斷地裝出笑臉，內心卻竭盡全力，

en.t: Outwardly I kept forcing a smiling face, while inwardly I was straining with all my might,

units.source_text: 在千分之一的成功率下，謹小慎微，汗流浹背地效勞於人。

en.t: serving others with the utmost caution, drenched in sweat, under odds of success no better than one in a thousand.

units.source_text: 從小，就連自己的家人，我也猜不出他們有多麼痛苦，腦子裡在想著什麼，

en.t: Since childhood, even with my own family, I could not guess how much they were suffering or what they were thinking about,

units.source_text: 我只是時常感到害怕，無法忍受那種尷尬，因此變成了搞笑高手。

en.t: I was simply often afraid and unable to bear that awkwardness, and so I became skilled at clowning around.

units.source_text: 也就是說，我在不知不覺中變成了一個不說一句真話的孩子。

en.t: In other words, before I knew it, I had become a child who never said a single true thing.
